test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.

Mukesh said to me, “You are wrong”.

options.text: Mukesh told me that you are wrong.
Mukesh tells me that I am wrong.
Mukesh told me that he was wrong.
Mukesh told me that I was wrong.

solution:
"The correct answer is **'Option 4'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence "Mukesh said to me, 'You are wrong'." is in direct speech.
 
• Converting it to indirect speech, the pronoun changes according to the context. Here, "you" is from Mukesh's perspective and would become "I" from the speaker's perspective.
 
• The correct verb form will be 'was' as past tense is used in indirect speech.
 
• Therefore, "Mukesh told me that I was wrong." is the correct conversion to indirect speech, which corresponds to option 4.

Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 4."**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] 

**Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1: "Mukesh told me that you are wrong." This is incorrect as the pronoun "you" doesn't change perspective when it should in indirect speech.
 
• Option 2: "Mukesh tells me that I am wrong." This changes the tense from past to present which is not accurate here.
 
• Option 3: "Mukesh told me that he was wrong." This inaccurately shifts the focus of the wrongness from 'me' (the speaker) to Mukesh himself.
